criteria.text: The inspector exposes an **Artifacts** tab on the session side panel.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c1: the session side panel exposes an Artifacts tab

criteria.text: Given representative persisted transcript parts, extraction returns only the four supported successful mutation forms, with IDs parsed from the specified source and no malformed IDs.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c2: extraction accepts only four successful mutation forms and their specified ID sources

criteria.text: IDs are deduped and sorted by latest successful mutation, and a later successful mutation for an existing artifact makes that artifact first.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c3: IDs are deduped newest-first and a later mutation promotes an existing artifact

criteria.text: Extraction cannot include a descendant subagent session when the exact inspected session has no matching mutation.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c4: extraction is scoped to the exact inspected session and excludes descendants

criteria.text: Older transcript pages are requested progressively until history is complete, a page fails, or the endpoint makes no progress; failure does not spin and exposes a retry path while preserving discovered rows.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c5: history pages stop on completion, failure, or no progress and retry without dropping rows

criteria.text: Metadata is fetched through hosted `LiveArtifactsDataSource.get`; a deleted, revoked, unavailable, or conflict result retains a useful row and does not reveal authorization details.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c6: hosted get resolves metadata and every unavailable outcome retains a generic useful row

criteria.text: The selector supports changing the selected artifact while only one interactive preview is mounted.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c7: changing the selector keeps exactly one interactive preview mounted

criteria.text: The preview uses the existing `LiveArtifactView` runtime and preserves its existing secure rendering behavior.
criteria.test_id: issue-1360-c8: preview composes the existing LiveArtifactView secure runtime
